headline: Shaw Farm community garden advances to next stage; regional animal control agreement with Blackstone approved
summary: Residents spoke against a proposed data center on the Unified site. Staff outlined the legal, financial, and technical reviews needed before any agreement. The meeting also approved 2026 holiday alcohol hours and the 2027 meeting schedule.
decisions: Approved the town manager entering an animal control agreement with Blackstone and five other towns, 5-0.
Allowed the Shaw Farm community garden to move to the next stage, with final approval to come later, 5-0.
Approved 2026 holiday hours for alcohol license holders, 5-0.
Approved the 2027 Select Board meeting schedule, 5-0.
discussion: Data center proposal: Public speakers opposed the project, citing water use, power demand, and noise. Board members said the proposal needs independent review and a benefits agreement before it goes to voters.
Shaw Farm garden site: Discussion covered a bobolink nesting area, an old well, and the master plan. Board members suggested finding a spot that avoids the hay field and the cross-country course.
Town manager authority: Board members discussed a charter line giving the town manager control over town property. They want guidance on which decisions must come to the board first.
Animal control fees: Staff described a $40 daily fee for held animals. Fees are waived for some medical and mental health holds.
